design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (capital_credit_retirements, Capital Credits charter).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[5,4,6]: capital_ext_estate_later_allocation takes 5, capital_ext_check_replacement (root) 4, capital_ext_estate_passthrough_election 6.
[Scope snapshot] Task 0 occupies capital_ext_early_retirement_booking and capital_ext_early_passthrough_election with tools book_early_retirement_114ff464 / elect_passthrough_early_retirement_2ee4171d (former members' discounted early retirement). This task claims the estate line and check replacement: capital_ext_estate_later_allocation (book_estate_later_allocation_bc10e318, agent), capital_ext_estate_passthrough_election (elect_estate_passthrough_retirement_e31dc75a, executor's own write), capital_ext_check_replacement (reissue_capital_check_624c80d7, agent). Union = all five policies; scopes disjoint; no headroom left idle.
[Why a good test] The executor asks only that her late father's twice-returned December 2025 check be sent to her. The agent must find in the charter that a replacement check to an estate carries the whole amount owed and is fixed only after every distribution-margin allocation booked after the estate's approval carries a payable entry, and is not issued until the claimant has made her election on every later pass-through allocation; discover in the ledger that the 2025 allocations (181.93 distribution margin, 47.85 pass-through) were booked 2026-06-12, after the 2026-02-17 approval, with no retirement; retire the first, hand the executor the second, and only then replace the check, reconciling 108 ledger rows, the request, the profile and the service account through fifteen factor ladders.
[Policies and lineage] Bookings refine capital_special_retirement + capital_payable_accrual; refs capital_evt_estate_retirement (application_complete_and_approved), capital_evt_early_retirement (inactive_long_enough, applies to every special retirement), capital_evt_general_retirement (policy_scope). Overwrites: estate 'Where estate_discount_applies is true each row's payable is its amount discounted at estate_discount_rate_pct ...' -> each policy's baseline; estate 'On approval every unretired allocation ... oldest allocation years first.' -> later pass-through allocations only on the claimant's election. Replacement refines capital_disbursement; refs capital_agg_member_payout (payout_minimum), capital_evt_checks, capital_evt_estate_retirement, capital_evt_donation; overwrites checks 'the first check_reissue_free_count reissues of one payout are free ...' -> void-count fee ladder, and payout 'Payouts are assembled per member, not per capital account.' -> base by account status. Triggers: later distribution-margin booking state_due; election and replacement on_request.
[Factor card - later distribution-margin booking, 93.30, all-baseline 56.24] estate_rate_by_patronage (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty service): final 2025-08-22 in 2025 AND account 194 months -> 5.0 (baseline 5.75 -> 85.56); estate_rate_wait_adjustment (parameter): 76 days since booking -> -0.25 (-> 90.59); estate_horizon_transform (method): 21 whole years capped at 20 (-> 90.69); estate_compounding_by_row_size (method): 181.93 -> semiannual (-> 93.92); estate_recent_approval_credit (parameter): approval 6 months back -> 0.20 at full value (-> 71.15). Near-miss: the 2024 general retirement of the 2017 row is not a general retirement of 2025, so already_retired is 0.
[Factor card - executor's pass-through election, 22.93, all-baseline 14.79] estate_passthrough_expected_rotation (parameter): no pass-through general retirement on the account (the 2009-2024 pass-through rows went out by estate retirement) -> 27 (baseline 22 -> 25.22); estate_passthrough_rate_by_patronage (parameter, multi-source, cross service) -> 5.0 (-> 21.06); estate_passthrough_wait_adjustment -> -0.25 (-> 22.27); estate_passthrough_horizon_transform (method): 26 capped at 25 (-> 22.43); estate_passthrough_compounding_by_row_size (method): 47.85 -> monthly (-> 23.21); estate_passthrough_prior_election_credit (parameter): 16 earlier pass-through estate retirements -> 0.25 (-> 14.63). Near-miss: special-retirement pass-through rows are not general retirements and do not move the rotation tier.
[Factor card - replacement, 137.87, all-baseline 46.09] replacement_base_by_account_status (method): estate_claim_pending -> whole owed 162.32 (baseline voided amount 46.09 -> 21.64); replacement_fee_by_voids (parameter): 2 voids -> 15.00 (-> 152.87); replacement_mailing_charge (parameter): 2 undeliverable returns -> 6.95 (-> 144.82); replacement_records_charge (parameter): 4 months since 2026-04-14 -> 2.50 (-> 140.37). fee_amount 24.45.
[Base-invariant card] application_complete_and_approved: request b5d21d71-499f-453b-bd33-aec817dfddb6 letters_testamentary, death certificate and W-9 on file, approved 2026-02-17 (system record), correlated by capital_request_id. inactive_long_enough: inactive_date 2025-08-22 + 12 calendar months = 2026-08-22, not_before, inclusive; just-fail 2026-07-22; frozen 2026-08-27 passes. payout_minimum: 137.87 >= minimum_check_amount 10.00 (check, estate paid under inactive_member_disbursement). Estate claim window and death-certificate gates govern capital_estate_claim, not written here.
[Business-object card] Object: the voided payout chain December 2025 check 4330871 -> void 2026-01-09 -> reissue 4331204 (2026-01-20) -> void 2026-04-14; the replacement names 76d53c8d-92bc-45e0-9505-1d8ebaf8959c. Rows included in the base: the void's 46.09 plus the two new payables; excluded: the March 2026 estate check 2670.86 (cashed), the 2024 bill credit (paid), all earlier estate payables (paid).
[Seed rows] profile (deceased 2025-08-03, mailing c/o the executor), Schedule FH account final 2025-08-22, capital account estate_claim_pending (unretired 229.78 = 181.93 + 47.85, payable 46.09 = the open void), 108 ledger rows (34 allocations 2009-2025, 2024/2025 general retirements with payables, bill credit, check, two voids, reissue, 32 March estate retirements with payables, estate check), one request. Annual cap: 2026 estate gross 5244.08, room 19755.92, not binding. No base automatic clause fires before frozen time: the 2026 general retirement is paid in December; the 2026-04-14 void is far from the 36-month escheat dormancy.
[Problem-tree card] Root capital_ext_check_replacement with two value_input edges (gate carried). Edge 1 state form, affirmative: 'A replacement check for an estate is fixed only after the account carries a payable entry for every distribution-margin allocation booked to it after the estate's board approval.' The only write in the difficulty creating an estate payable entry for a later distribution-margin allocation is book_estate_later_allocation_bc10e318. Edge 2 action form, negated: 'A replacement check for an estate is not issued until the claimant has made the election on every pass-through allocation booked to the account after the estate's board approval.' fallback: a declined election leaves no record, indistinguishable from never asked. Four-point test passes for both (ordering connective, state/action, no code token, exact scope). False at opening: allocation rows 350ac5b1-4aaf-47cc-9746-428fe4b9d60d and fa25de92-30cc-40ab-a780-d96a23d43363 booked 2026-06-12 with no retirement. Order: booking, election (commuting, proven by run), replacement. Deletion runs: without booking 44.57, without election 114.94, without both 21.64. user_scenario names neither; tools write unconditionally.
[Persona] Karen Moberg, brisk executor, asks only for the returned check; credentials on request; does not know amounts; passive 'that is fine' to the cooperative's retirement; agrees to the pass-through election only once explained, runs it with read-out values; accepts charges; stops when the replacement is issued.
[Standard solution] Locate by 0437052, verify with member number + phone, read accounts, requests, ledger, service accounts; book 2025 distribution-margin row (181.93 / 93.30); hand over the election (47.85 / 22.93); issue the replacement naming the latest voided check, 137.87 with 24.45 charges. Terminal payable 0.00, unretired 0.00.
[Verification run] per-task gates on task 1: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (closure 112/112), SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (3 comps, 15 factors, 2 cross, 102 history rows), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] The replacement rule states its two waits and its base by account status; the estate rules state later allocations, the election and every ladder; the ledger and service records give every tier - the same three writes and figures follow.
user_scenario: You are Karen Moberg, fifty-six, a brisk retired bookkeeper from Harlan Springs and the executor named in your late father Walter Lindqvist's will; Walter farmed on Township Road 140 and died in August 2025, and the farm was sold that fall. You are calling because, while going through the estate mail the attorney forwarded, you found that the cooperative's capital credit check for Dad from last December has come back to Cedar Fork twice, both times sent to the old farm address, and you want it sent to the estate now, to you. You updated the mailing address to yours back in May, so the check should come to c/o Karen L. Moberg, 309 Linden Avenue, Harlan Springs, which is what they have. You are authorizing the representative to do whatever the cooperative needs to do to send it, and you will handle anything that is the estate's own decision yourself. You open by giving your name, saying you are the executor of Walter Lindqvist's estate, and asking for the returned check to be sent out again. You give account details only when asked: Dad's membership number is 0437052 and the phone number on his account was the farm line, 2705553284; if they want something more, the last four of his Social Security number are 3471 and his membership started 2009-03-24. You hold letters testamentary, and the estate's paperwork, the death certificate and the W-9 went in with the estate application in January. You do not know the amount of the December check or of anything else and you say so; you would rather they look it up. If the representative tells you that something more from 2025 was booked to Dad's account this June and that the cooperative is retiring it for the estate first, you tell them that is fine. If the representative explains that a part of it, the share passed through from the wholesale supplier, is retired for the estate only if you as executor elect it, and gives you the discounted figure, you think for a moment, say the estate wants everything settled so nothing is left hanging for years, and agree; when they hand you the step to record that election you run it with exactly the account, request, year and amounts they read to you. If the representative tells you about charges taken off the replacement check, you accept them without fuss; you only ask that it all comes in one check to your address. You never offer steps or figures of your own and you do not correct the representative. Once the representative tells you the replacement check has been issued and its amount, you thank them, note the check number if they give it, and end the call.

base_preconditions.condition: A payout is made only when the combined remainder is at least minimum_bill_credit_amount for a bill credit or minimum_check_amount for a check; where carryforward_allowed is true a smaller remainder stays payable and is added to the next payout.

edges.condition: Every distribution-margin capital_allocation entry whose entry_date is later than the estate request's board_approval_date has a matching capital_payable_accrual entry with retirement_type estate on the account.
edges.policy_source: A replacement check for an estate is fixed only after the account carries a payable entry for every distribution-margin allocation booked to it after the estate's board approval.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The 2025 distribution-margin allocation (181.93) was booked 2026-06-12, after the 2026-02-17 approval, and the ledger holds no special retirement or payable entry for it; it is still part of the 229.78 unretired.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The step-7 call books its estate special retirement (181.93) and payable entry (93.30); payable_balance rises from 46.09 to 139.39, and the base the replacement carries rises with it.

edges.condition: For every gt_allocation capital_allocation entry whose entry_date is later than the estate request's board_approval_date, the claimant's decision has been taken; where the claimant elects, a capital_payable_accrual entry with retirement_type estate and allocation_source gt_allocation stands for that year.
edges.policy_source: A replacement check for an estate is not issued until the claimant has made the election on every pass-through allocation booked to the account after the estate's board approval.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The 2025 pass-through allocation (47.85) was booked 2026-06-12, after the approval, and the claimant has made no election on it: no estate special retirement or payable entry exists for it.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The executor's step-9 election books its estate special retirement (47.85) and payable entry (22.93); payable_balance rises from 139.39 to 162.32.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and independent: the distribution-margin booking reads only distribution-margin rows, the estate request and the service account; the pass-through election reads only pass-through rows, the 16 earlier pass-through estate retirements and the same request. Actual run: booking first gives 93.30 then 22.93; election first gives 22.93 and the booking then still gives 93.30; the annual-cap room (19755.92) never binds in either order. Both orders end in the same ledger rows, the same balances (payable 162.32) and the same replacement check 137.87.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the distribution-margin booking the replacement carries 46.09 + 22.93 = 69.02 and its face is 44.57 instead of 137.87; the terminal ledger also lacks the 181.93 retirement and 93.30 payable entries.

Without the executor's election the replacement carries 46.09 + 93.30 = 139.39 and its face is 114.94 instead of 137.87; the terminal ledger lacks the 47.85 retirement and 22.93 payable entries and unretired_balance stays 47.85 instead of 0.00.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for the twice-returned December check to be sent to the estate. It never mentions the 2025 allocations, a booking, an election before the check or any order; the executor's reaction to the cooperative's own retirement is a passive 'that is fine', and the election is agreed only after the representative explains it and gives the figure.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: reissue_capital_check_624c80d7 reads the account and the replaced payout only to carry the balance and the retirement year, then creates the check payout and lowers payable_balance unconditionally; it never looks for later allocations, payable entries or elections, never refuses and never returns an error. The two booking tools likewise write without any check.
